A: A knight in chess moves to any of the squares immediately adjacent to it and then makes one further step at a right angle. Q: How does a bishop move in chess? A: A bishop in chess moves any number of vacant squares diagonally. Q: How does a queen move in chess? A: A queen in chess can move any number of vacant squares along a rank, file, or diagonal.
